title: Days Gone
subtitle: A motorcycle through a damaged Oregon
summary: Days Gone is Bend Studio's open-world action-adventure, released for PlayStation 4 on 26 April 2019. Deacon St. John survives in Oregon after a pandemic has transformed much of the population into hostile creatures known as Freakers. Working between camps, he begins to suspect that his wife Sarah may still be alive. His motorcycle connects the places and people left in this landscape. body: Days Gone is Bend Studio's open-world action-adventure, released for PlayStation 4 on 26 April 2019. Deacon St. John survives in Oregon after a pandemic has transformed much of the population into hostile creatures known as Freakers. Working between camps, he begins to suspect that his wife Sarah may still be alive. His motorcycle connects the places and people left in this landscape. Travel requires fuel and maintenance, making the vehicle a continuing concern rather than an endlessly available means of crossing the map.

Freakers can gather into large hordes whose numbers change the meaning of an ordinary fight. The player can use explosives, traps, the surrounding terrain and planned escape routes to reduce their advantage. Starting an encounter without supplies or a working route back to the motorcycle can quickly become a mistake. Smaller threats and human opponents give other uses to stealth, firearms and improvised weapons. The open world therefore asks for preparation on two scales: the immediate approach to a target and the resources needed to leave once the situation changes.

Camps provide jobs, trading and relationships that draw Deacon across the map between the main story's events. Weather and varied terrain give the same journey different conditions, supporting the central Oregon setting. The project marked Bend Studio's return to an original property after years of work on handheld games, with John Garvin writing and Nathan Whitehead composing. Its launch received mixed reviews, including criticism of technical problems and mission design. A Windows version followed in 2021, and the PlayStation 5 remaster arrived in 2025 with additional modes.
